crossRefs.note: Therefore whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do…

translations.web: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
translations.bsb: Do to others as you would have them do to you.
translations.kjv: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
translations.asv: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
